title: Tired of slow, steady love?
old_caption:
Flowers, sparks and "soulmate" on day one can feel thrilling. But most meteors are just dust burning up in the air.
Slow and steady love isn't boring. It's the kind that lasts.

title: Venus has gone missing.
old_caption: Needing space isn't the same as disappearing. A short note saying you need time and you'll be back saves everyone from guessing. Space is okay when you say so.

title: Morning Star
old_caption:
Venus spent the retrograde checking the rearview mirror for every ex. Now she's back as the Morning Star, rising early and lighter.
Looking back is part of healing. Growth is choosing to face the sunrise.

title: Welcome to the Museum of Exes.
old_caption: The hoodie, the playlist, all on display. Keeping sweet memories is fine. Holding on to their stuff can keep a door half open. Keep the memory, and kindly give the hoodie back.

title: Someone liked a photo from 2021.
old_caption:
A 2 a.m. like on a photo from 2021, from someone who watches every story but never texts. Detective Scorpio closes the case.
You're allowed to block what keeps unsettling your peace.

title: The orbiter, in its natural habitat.
old_caption:
It watches every story but never texts. That kind of quiet attention can keep you guessing.
Watching isn't wanting. It's okay to mute what doesn't add to your life and focus on people who show up.

title: Ophiuchus is in love. It’s been two days.
old_caption: Two days in, a 412-song shared playlist and meeting the parents. When love moves that fast after a hard ending, pause. Heal first. Good love will still be there afterward.

title: The twin built a time machine.
old_caption: Going back to an ex to fix it this time? Sometimes the same fight just replays on a loop. Look back to learn something, then point yourself toward tomorrow.

title: Venus has been drawing a rose.
old_caption: Seen from Earth, Venus loops backward again and again, and over eight years those loops trace a five-petal rose. Your setbacks can shape something beautiful too, if you learn from each one.

title: ooooh
old_caption:
Mars crashes on Aries and Libra's couch and keeps asking about Venus. They let him stay, with one kind boundary: no ex talk at dinner.
Other people's drama doesn't have to become yours.
